shared_elements: schematic stick-figure humans with outstretched arms
rock-carved outline figures painted/filled in red
human figure holding or attached to a long linear object
figures scattered across an open rock surface without frame
justification: Both surfaces show the same repertoire of highly schematic red-filled rock-carved figures: stick-like humans with straight outstretched arms and splayed legs, small profile quadrupeds, and long linear objects held or extended by the figures, drawn with identical linear/silhouette conventions and no framing or ground line. The decisive difference is that B is dominated by repeated crescent-hulled boats with rows of vertical crew-strokes, which are entirely absent from A, where the scene is a close-up group of large human figures and animals connected by a long horizontal line.
